objective: Measure whether Q4_K WDC can fit and win when q6_K reorder is explicitly suppressed, avoiding the 1.27-billion-element output-head temporary copy.
advance_to_full_ladder_if: Clean completion; banner force_reorder=0, force_q4k=1, disable_q6k=1; non-mutant q4_K WDC-CENSUS engagement; B64 at least 1.05x control; B1 at least 0.95x control. Suppressing q6_K reorder may regress output-head performance, so both speed thresholds are mandatory.
quality_boundary: Raw random-token mechanism evidence only. Endpoint sequential-oracle validation is mandatory before promotion.
